title: Governed Production full promotion dispatch bridge

phases.objective: Route an explicit governed Production promotion request through the authoritative convergence launcher rather than the legacy candidate-builder-only path.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An authorized same-repository request PR receives DISPATCH_GOVERNED_PRODUCTION_PROMOTION or the bridge is manually dispatched with an exact request-head SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bridge proves current-main/request-tree parity and Production ancestry, dispatches the authoritative promotion launcher with exact pins and typed confirmation, and emits canonical evidence without directly mutating Production.
steps: Validate trusted commenter or typed manual request identity.
Read and pin current main, current Production, and the exact request PR head.
Require the request head to descend from and be tree-identical to current main.
Re-read all exact refs immediately before dispatch.
Dispatch governed-production-promotion-request-launcher.yml with exact main and request-head pins.
Persist the canonical dispatch decision before attempting the optional PR receipt comment.
Treat receipt-comment transport failure as non-fatal after a launcher run has been captured.
assertions: The full bridge never dispatches production-promotion-candidate.yml directly.
The launcher receives exact current main and exact tree-identical request-head SHAs.
The bridge uses bounded human or ai_policy review mode only.
A moved main, Production ref, or request head fails closed before launcher dispatch.
Canonical dispatch evidence exists independently of optional issue-comment transport.
No Production merge, deployment, migration, grant, provider mutation, credential payload read, protected-ref mutation, or force push is performed by the bridge.

phases.objective: Keep exact protected-ref and request-head currentness checks adjacent to launcher dispatch.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The bridge has accepted an eligible governed promotion request and pinned exact main, Production, and request-head SHAs.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The launcher is dispatched only while all three protected/request refs still equal their pinned identities; any intervening movement fails closed before dispatch.
steps: Pin exact current main, Production, and request-head SHAs during request resolution.
Prove the request head descends from and is tree-identical to current main, and current Production is contained by main.
Immediately before launcher dispatch, independently re-read main, Production, and request-head identities.
Abort before launcher dispatch if any re-read differs from its pinned SHA.
Dispatch the authoritative launcher only with the exact pinned main and request-head values.
assertions: Main currentness is checked both against the trusted workflow source and immediately before launcher dispatch.
Production and request-head identities are re-read immediately before launcher dispatch.
Request-head ancestry and tree identity are proven before promotion orchestration proceeds.
The launcher receives exact main and request-head pins rather than floating branch identity.
No direct Production mutation is performed by the bridge.

phases.objective: Fail closed on ref races and preserve successful dispatch evidence when optional receipt transport is unavailable.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A governed promotion request encounters protected-ref movement, request-head movement, a duplicate matching launcher run, or unavailable optional PR receipt-comment transport.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Ref races fail closed before a new launcher dispatch, duplicate active/successful launcher work is suppressed, and a successful new dispatch remains canonically recorded even if the optional receipt comment cannot be written.
steps: Re-read pinned main, Production, and request-head identities immediately before dispatch and fail closed on any mismatch.
Inspect canonical prior launch receipts and suppress a duplicate when a matching launcher run is active or already successful.
Capture the newly dispatched authoritative launcher run ID before attempting optional receipt transport.
Persist outcome=dispatched and launcher_run_id in decision.json before posting the optional PR receipt comment.
Downgrade receipt-comment transport failure to a warning without erasing successful launcher dispatch evidence.
assertions: A moved main, Production ref, or request head cannot race through to launcher dispatch.
A matching active or successful launcher run is duplicate-suppressed rather than dispatched again.
Canonical dispatch evidence is persisted before optional receipt-comment transport.
Receipt-comment transport failure is non-fatal only after a launcher run has been captured and recorded.
The resilient path does not merge or directly mutate Production.

phases.objective: This bridge grants no provider, deployment, or database mutation authority.
Final Production mutation remains outside this bridge and subject to the downstream governed release PR gates.
